description: This PHP script generates a sitemap for the Home module in a SuiteCRM environment. It constructs an HTML representation of module links, handles localization, and dynamically loads module menus. It also utilizes Smarty templating to display the sitemap.

methods.name: sm_build_array
methods.description: Builds or retrieves from session an array representing module menus for the sitemap, including localization and access checks.
